doc: Idefics3 / SmolVLM (Idefics3ForConditionalGeneration): the TEXT decoder of the wrapper — a Llama under `model.text_model.*` with a top-level `lm_head`; the SigLIP-style tower (`model.vision_model.*`), the pixel-shuffle connector (`model.connector.*`) and the image tokens belong to the vision stage. Third-party adapter (lane H): data only.
